correctness.rationale: Stationary angular covariance is 1/2 e^(−γ|u|)cos(ωu). A harmonic filter multiplies its two-Lorentzian spectrum by 1/(κ²+ν²), giving rational F_(h,t)(z)=(1+t+z)/[(h+z)(z²+2(1−t)z+(1+t)²)]. Independently differentiated and recovered P=−2z³−(5+h+t)z²+2(1+t)(2t−2−h)z−(1+t)[(1+t)²+h(1−3t)], at h=1 discriminant 16t⁴(1+t)(17t−108) and factor at t_c=108/17 −2/4913(17z−55)²(17z+215). Derivative sign yields precisely 1 peak below/at threshold, 3 peaks above, shoulders not extrema at t_c. Taylor derivatives give z_±=55/17±(2/√5)√(t−t_c)+O(t−t_c). P(0) yields the exact h>16/9 central-minimum open wedge. Finite symbolic checks corroborate the global algebra; no full unequal-rate diagram is asserted.
